description: Notification channel abstraction and the complete Pest feature test suite (Phase2ServicesTest.php). Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 being complete. This is the last FEAT.
steps: Create app/Notifications/Channels/NotificationChannelInterface.php: `namespace App\Notifications\Channels; interface NotificationChannelInterface { public function send(\App\Models\User $notifiable, \App\Notifications\LeaveRequestNotification $notification): void; }`

Create app/Notifications/LeaveRequestNotification.php as a standard Laravel Notification. Constructor: `public function __construct(public readonly LeaveRequest $request, public readonly string $event, public readonly string $message)`. Implement `via(object $notifiable): array` — return ['database'] always; append 'mail' if config('leave.email_notifications') is true. Implement `toDatabase(object $notifiable): array` — return ['leave_request_id' => $this->request->id, 'number' => $this->request->number, 'event' => $this->event, 'message' => $this->message, 'status' => $this->request->status->value]. Implement `toMail(object $notifiable): \Illuminate\Notifications\Messages\MailMessage` — subject: 'إشعار إجازة: ' . $this->event; greeting: 'عزيزي ' . $notifiable->name; line: $this->message; line: 'رقم الطلب: ' . $this->request->number.

Create app/Notifications/Channels/DatabaseChannel.php: implements NotificationChannelInterface. `public function send(User $notifiable, LeaveRequestNotification $notification): void { $notifiable->notify($notification); }` — delegates to Laravel's built-in notification system.

Create app/Notifications/Channels/EmailChannel.php: implements NotificationChannelInterface. `public function send(User $notifiable, LeaveRequestNotification $notification): void { if (!config('leave.email_notifications')) { \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log::info('[EmailChannel] email_notifications disabled; skipping.', ['user' => $notifiable->id, 'event' => $notification->event]); return; } \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Mail::to($notifiable->email)->queue(new \App\Mail\LeaveRequestMail($notification)); }` — Note: LeaveRequestMail does not need to be created in Phase 2; wrap the Mail call in a try/catch or check if the mailable exists; alternatively just log if mail is disabled (which it is in tests).
Ensure User model has the Notifiable trait (it should already be present in Laravel default User — verify at app/Models/User.php and add `use Illuminate\Notifications\Notifiable;` if missing).

Create tests/Feature/Phase2ServicesTest.php. Structure: use RefreshDatabase (inherited via Pest.php uses()). Import all needed classes at top. Use `createHierarchy()` helper from Pest.php. Organise with describe() blocks: 'LeaveBalanceService', 'ValidationRules', 'LeaveRequestService lifecycle', 'Notifications'.

Write LeaveBalanceService tests inside describe('LeaveBalanceService'): it('getOrCreateBalance creates balance with correct entitlement for regular leave', ...): create employee with TEACHER grade (28 days), get/create balance for regular leave type, expect entitled=28. it('getOrCreateBalance returns existing balance on second call'): call twice, assert only 1 row in DB. it('deduct increments used and appends deduction transaction'): create fresh balance (used=0, entitled=30), deduct 5 days, assert balance->fresh()->used==5.0, assert transaction exists with type=deduction, days=5. it('refund decrements used and appends refund transaction'): set used=10, refund 4, assert used==6.0, transaction type=refund. it('refund floors used at zero'): set used=2, refund 10, assert used==0.0. it('adjust with positive days increments entitled'): adjust +10, assert entitled incremented. it('adjust with negative days decrements used'): set used=8, adjust -3, assert used=5. it('carryOver creates carried_over in next year balance'): create 2026 balance (entitled=30, used=10, remaining=20), carryOver(emp, 2026, 2027), assert 2027 balance carried_over==20. it('accrueAnnual sets entitled on all active leave types'): accrueAnnual, assert regular balance entitled==employee->regularLeaveEntitlement().

Write ValidationRules tests inside describe('ValidationRules'): it('WorkingDaysRule excludes Fridays and Saturdays'): create rule, set $rule->data=['start_date'=>'2026-01-05','end_date'=>'2026-01-11'] (Mon-Sun), run validate, assert calculatedDays==5 (5 working days Mon-Fri minus Fri+Sat = Mon-Thu + Sun? — actually Mon=1,Tue=2,Wed=3,Thu=4,Fri=5,Sat=6,Sun=0 so Mon-Sun with skip Fri(5)+Sat(6) = 5 days: Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Sun). it('WorkingDaysRule excludes holidays from holidays table'): seed 1 holiday on a Wednesday in the range, assert calculatedDays reduced by 1. it('SufficientBalanceRule warns when warn_only=true'): set config('leave.warn_only_insufficient_balance', true), create balance with remaining=5, run rule with value=10, assert no validation failure and $rule->warning is not null. it('SufficientBalanceRule fails when warn_only=false'): set config to false, expect $fail called. it('NoOverlapRule blocks overlapping active request'): create SUBMITTED request for same employee on overlapping dates, run rule, assert fail called. it('NoOverlapRule passes for rejected overlapping request'): create REJECTED request, run rule, no fail. it('MaxDaysPerRequestRule blocks excess days'): leaveType with max_days_per_request=7, validate value=10, expect fail. it('CasualBeforeRegularRule warns for 1-2 day regular with casual balance'): set up employee with casual balance remaining=3, run rule for regular leave 1 day, assert warning not null. it('CasualBeforeRegularRule does not warn when no casual balance'): casual remaining=0, run rule, assert warning null.

Write LeaveRequestService lifecycle tests inside describe('LeaveRequestService lifecycle'): Setup in beforeEach: $orgs = createHierarchy(); $emp = Employee::factory()->inOrganization($orgs['school'])->withGrade(EntitlementGrade::TEACHER)->create(); $user = User::factory()->inOrganization($orgs['school'])->create(); $lt = LeaveType::where('code','regular')->firstOrFail() OR LeaveType::factory()->regular()->create(); create 3-stage WorkflowConfiguration for $orgs['school'] using factory helpers. Tests: it('create returns DRAFT request with CreateLeaveRequestResult'): create WorkingDays-compatible dates (Mon-Thu), call service->create([employee_id, leave_type_id, start_date, end_date, days=4], $user), assert instanceof CreateLeaveRequestResult, assert ->request->status==DRAFT. it('submit builds steps from WorkflowConfiguration'): create, then submit, assert $request->fresh()->steps->count()==3, assert status==SUBMITTED, assert current_stage=='direct_manager'. it('submit snapshots balance columns'): after submit, assert request->balance_entitled not null. it('approve with ANY rule advances to next stage after single approval'): submit request, approve step 1, assert status==IN_REVIEW, assert current_stage=='leaves_officer'. it('approve at final stage sets APPROVED and deducts balance'): submit, approve all 3 stages (step by step), assert final status==APPROVED, assert LeaveBalance->used == $request->days. it('approve with ALL rule waits for second approver'): change direct_manager stage approval_rule to ALL, create 2 step rows for that stage (same step_order? — NOTE: current schema has unique(leave_request_id, step_order) so multiple approvers at the same stage must use different step_orders or a different model. Given the schema has 1 row per step_order, ALL rule with single approver means all=1/1=satisfied. Test ALL with single approver: assert advancing works correctly). it('reject sets REJECTED and skips remaining steps'): submit, reject step 1, assert status==REJECTED, assert steps 2 and 3 are SKIPPED. it('returnRequest sets RETURNED and skips remaining'): submit, returnRequest step 1, assert status==RETURNED. it('cancel on DRAFT does not touch balance'): create request, cancel, assert status==CANCELLED, assert LeaveBalance used unchanged. it('cancel throws exception for terminal status'): create approved request, assert LeaveRequestException thrown on cancel? No — APPROVED is not in canBeCancelled(). Test: set status=APPROVED via factory, expect exception. it('submit throws exception when already SUBMITTED'): submit twice, expect LeaveRequestException on second call.

Write Notification tests inside describe('Notifications'): it('DatabaseChannel::send stores notification on user'): $user->notifications is empty, DatabaseChannel->send($user, new LeaveRequestNotification($request,'submitted','تم تقديم طلبك')), assert $user->fresh()->notifications->count()==1. it('LeaveRequestNotification toDatabase returns expected shape'): assert array has keys leave_request_id, number, event, message, status.
Run full test suite to confirm all Phase 2 tests pass and Phase 1 tests are unaffected.
acceptance_criteria: LeaveRequestNotification::toDatabase() returns array with keys: leave_request_id, number, event, message, status
DatabaseChannel::send() stores a database notification entry on the User
EmailChannel::send() logs and returns early when email_notifications config is false
All describe blocks in Phase2ServicesTest.php pass (balance service, validation rules, lifecycle, notifications)
Running ./vendor/bin/pest --no-coverage exits 0 with no new failures (pre-existing Phase 1 failure about null grade is ignored)
